code_delta: V7 changes selection/source binding, fixed safe alias, private path, nonce/release identity and terminal schema. It does not broaden the remote SSH command or v6 success proof; its exact node copy comes from a source file whose SHA is rechecked before credential write.
falsifiable_risks: Historical 51 ms alternate delay is not gz02-specific reachability; one-shot SSH can still return rc255 and consume its nonce.

Selection and credential write are sequential, not atomic; source/PID/socket/current leaf are rechecked, but future controller behavior after final read is only bounded by private config and later SSH proof.

V7 retains the v6 failure-path raw stderr cleanup limit: an rc255 marker may be runner-reported yet not independently replayable after private logs are deleted; preserve UNKNOWN where raw safe witness is absent.
EVO54 node-outbound witness remains pilot only. This v7 code review neither requires it nor treats /32 rule selection as node TCP proof.
